parameters.query:
INSERT INTO comments (comment_id, post_id, author_id, author_name, author_email, comment_text, parent_comment_id, spam_score, status, created_at)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9, NOW())
ON CONFLICT (comment_id) DO UPDATE
SET status = $9, spam_score = $8, updated_at = NOW();

SELECT u.user_id, u.email, u.notification_preferences, p.title as post_title, p.url as post_url
FROM users u
JOIN blog_posts p ON p.post_id = $1
WHERE u.user_id = p.user_id AND u.notification_preferences->>'comments' = 'true';
